Talent0_2Ability.name: Morning Star
Talent0_2Ability.SpecificEffects: At the start of battle, automatically deploys <terrian ID=3014501 />. Can use command skills <skill mainSkill=301452>[Deploy Sentry]</skill> and <skill mainSkill=301453>[Sworn Enemy]</skill>. When an ally attack an enemy within range, performs <buf ID=900002>[Link Attack]</buf> with Sniper Rifle, dealing <color=#F74848>0.35x</color> DMG, prioritizing hitting the same part with the ally's attack, up to <color=#F74848>3</color> times per turn. If the <buf ID=900002>[Link Attack]</buf> destroys a part, it is considered as if the ally destroys a part. When performing attacks other than <buf ID=900153>[Weapon Skill]</buf>, gains <color=#F74848>1</color> stack of <buf ID=3014508>[Determination]</buf>, up to <color=#F74848>5</color> stacks.

300001.name: Sniper Warfare 1
300001.SpecificEffects: When destroying a target, <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf> can be triggered, effective up to <color=#F74848>2</color> times per turn. Unable to move before attacking.

301402.name: Boiling Blood
301402.SpecificEffects: When an enemy carrying <buf ID=3014505>[Arch-Enemy]</buf> is destroyed, [Bertha] gains <color=#F74848>2</color> stacks <buf ID=3014508>[Determination]</buf>.

301403.name: One Shot, One Kill
301403.describe: Uses a Sniper Rifle to attack a target, dealing <color=#F74848>1.4x</color> DMG. This attack always hits the body. This attack does not consume <buf ID=3014508>[Determination]</buf> stacks if it destroys a target.

301404.name: Self-Motivated
301404.SpecificEffects: When actively attacking with <buf ID=900153>[Weapon Skill]</buf>, for each <color=#F74848>1</color> stack of <buf ID=3014508>[Determination]</buf> [Bertha] is carrying, restores <color=#F74848>1</color> AP, up to <color=#F74848>2</color> AP. This effect can trigger <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.

301405.name: Duelist Soul
301405.SpecificEffects: After destroying a target carrying <buf ID=3014505>[Arch-Enemy]</buf>, [Bertha] gains <buf ID=3014053>[Duelist Soul]</buf>, stacking up to <color=#F74848>2</color> times.

301406.name: Highlights
301406.describe: Immediately gains <color=#F74848>2</color> AP and <color=#F74848>3</color> stacks of <buf ID=3014508>[Determination]</buf>. Can continue to act with remaining movement.

301407.name: Long Range Welcome
301407.SpecificEffects: When [Bertha] is <color=#F74848>4</color> tiles or more away from the target, when attacking with Sniper Rifle, for each <color=#F74848>1</color> tile further than <color=#F74848>4</color>, Final DMG dealt increases by <color=#F74848>5%</color>, up to <color=#F74848>15%</color>.

301408.name: Bertha Assault
301408.describe: Uses a Sniper Rifle to attack a target, dealing <color=#F74848>1.35x</color> DMG. Enters <buf ID=900014>[Aiming]</buf> Mode before attacking. For each <color=#F74848>2</color> stacks of <buf ID=3014508>[Determination]</buf>, performs <color=#F74848>1</color> additional attack, prioritizing hitting the same part. Each additional attack DMG reduces by <color=#F74848>15%</color>, up to <color=#F74848>60%</color>.

300011.name: Sniper Warfare 2
300011.SpecificEffects: After breaking a part, trigger <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf>.

300021.name: Sniper Warfare 3
300021.SpecificEffects: Upon triggering <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf>, allows movement of <color=#F74848>2</color> tiles before attacking.

300022.name: Power Innovation 2
300022.SpecificEffects: When breaking a part, restore <color=#F74848>1</color> AP after combat, effective up to <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.

301231.name: Hunting Mark 1
301231.SpecificEffects: When actively attacking and breaking parts with a ranged weapon, gains <buf ID=900141>[Hunting]</buf> according to the part hit. Can trigger <color=#F74848>2</color> times per turn.

301234.name: Hunting Mark 2
301234.SpecificEffects: After actively attacking and destroying a target with a ranged weapon, can additionally move <color=#F74848>3</color> tiles.

301235.name: Hunting Mark 3
301235.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900142>[Hunting Mark 1]</buf> no longer has trigger limit

301236.name: Hunting Mark 4
301236.SpecificEffects: At the start of action, randomly gains <color=#F74848>1</color> of unobtained <buf ID=900141>[Hunting]</buf> buffs.

301441.name: I Am Legend! 1
301441.SpecificEffects: When attacking enemies located within <terrian ID=3014501 />, Critical Hit chance increases by <color=#F74848>20%</color> and Critical Hit DMG increases by <color=#F74848>10%</color>.

300043.name: Power Innovation 3
300043.SpecificEffects: When destroying a target, additionally restore <color=#F74848>1</color> AP after combat, effective up to <color=#F74848>2</color> times per turn.

301444.name: I Am Legend! 2
301444.SpecificEffects: When attacking with Sniper Rifle, if the target is <color=#F74848>4</color> or more tiles away, skill multiplier increases by <color=#F74848>0.15</color> and [Normal Attack] can enters <buf ID=900014>[Aiming]</buf> Mode.

301445.name: I Am Legend! 3
301445.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900002>[Link Attack]</buf> limit increases to <color=#F74848>5</color> per turn. <buf ID=3014508>[Determination]</buf> max stacks increase to <color=#F74848>8</color>.

301446.name: I Am Legend! 4
301446.SpecificEffects: If an enemy carrying <buf ID=3014505>[Arch-Enemy]</buf> survives for <color=#F74848>1</color> turn or more, at the start of next turn, when [Bertha] actively attacks this target, ignores target's <buf ID=900160>[DMG Reduction]</buf> effect and applies <buf ID=3014464>[Global Repair Reduction]</buf>.

hiddenSkills.name: Surefire Plan
hiddenSkills.describe: Uses a Sniper Rifle to attack a target, dealing <color=#F74848>1.3x</color> DMG. Enters <buf ID=900014>[Aiming]</buf> Mode before attacking. If the target is carrying <buf ID=3014505>[Arch-Enemy]</buf>, this attack cannot be dodged.
